# Farvist

> A lightweight (~21 KB) glassmorphism CSS framework — frosted-glass surfaces, neon glow, gradients, a free backgrounds library, 42 components, five theme skins and dark/light modes. Drop in one `<link>`, no build step, MIT.

Farvist is dark-first (add `data-theme="light"` to `<html>` to switch) and uses a class model like Bootstrap's (components + utilities), but token-driven: every color derives from `--fv-*` custom properties at runtime, so overriding ~5 variables re-brands the entire framework — gradients, glows, meshes and hover states included. Built for AI products: chat thread, prompt composer, rendered-markdown `.prose`, tool-call cards, reasoning disclosures, citations, code diffs, prompt suggestions, attachments, a ⌘K command palette, and agent status.

## Start here (for AI assistants)
- [Agent Skill](https://farvist.com/.well-known/skills/farvist/SKILL.md): install with `npx skills add FloKuersten/farvist` (or `npx skills add https://farvist.com`) — short rules, with component/theming/recipe references loaded on demand.
- Validate generated markup: `npx farvist check <files>` — unknown or misspelled classes (with a suggestion), classes missing from the page's build, cross-origin icon sprites, unpinned or @latest CDN URLs. Project classes from `<style>` and relatively linked/imported stylesheets are read automatically; add other project CSS with `--css <file>` rather than renaming classes. `--json`; exit 1 on errors.
- [Full context](https://farvist.com/llms-full.txt): every convention, component, icon, design token and copy-paste recipe. Paste this into your assistant before generating Farvist markup.
- [Machine-readable catalog](https://farvist.com/ai-context.json): the same as JSON — components, utility families, design tokens with defaults, skins, icons, recipes.
- Project rules: [Cursor .mdc](https://farvist.com/ai/farvist.mdc) · [Copilot instructions](https://farvist.com/ai/farvist.instructions.md) · [AGENTS.md snippet](https://farvist.com/ai/AGENTS.snippet.md) · [legacy .cursorrules](https://farvist.com/farvist.cursorrules). MCP docs server: https://gitmcp.io/FloKuersten/farvist

## Docs & tools
- [Documentation](https://farvist.com/docs/): components, utilities, theming + skins, backgrounds, accessibility, the AI kit, the command palette.
- [Theme Builder](https://farvist.com/themer/): drag pickers, watch everything retheme live, copy the CSS.
- [Templates](https://farvist.com/templates/): AI console, SaaS landing, dashboard, auth, portfolio, block gallery — full pages to copy.
- [Live demo](https://farvist.com): every component on one page.
- [Blog](https://farvist.com/blog/): the engineering behind the framework (runtime theming, AI-era design, accessible glassmorphism).

## Install
- CDN: `<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/farvist@1/dist/farvist.min.css">`
- Optional JS: `<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/farvist@1/assets/farvist.js" defer></script>`
- npm: `npm i farvist`
- Three builds (swap the filename): `farvist.min.css` (~21 KB gzip, everything) · `farvist-slim.min.css` (~19 KB, no AI kit — the 11 excluded components: chat, prompt, status, prose, tool-call, reasoning, command, diff, suggestions, attachment, snippet) · `farvist-ai.min.css` (~6.6 KB, ONLY the AI-interface kit — add it to a site already on Tailwind/Bootstrap; no reset/grid/utilities, rem-sized against a 16px root, wrap the UI in `data-theme="light"` on light pages; on Tailwind v3 AND Bootstrap hosts also load `farvist-ai-compat.css` after the host stylesheet (Tailwind v4 needs nothing)).

## Conventions (quick reference)
- Colors: primary, secondary, success, danger, warning, info, accent, light, dark (suffixes: `btn-primary`, `text-success`, `bg-accent`).
- Breakpoints: sm 576, md 768, lg 992, xl 1200 — infix after the prefix: `col-md-6`, `d-lg-flex`.
- Spacing: 0–8 scale → `p-4` = 1rem, `gap-3` = .75rem, `m-8` = 4rem.
- Re-branding: override `--fv-primary` / `--fv-accent` / `--fv-info` on `:root` — everything follows at runtime. Skins: `data-theme="synthwave|cyber|noir|forest|dawn"`.
- Rendered LLM markdown goes inside `.prose` (use `.prose-sm` in chat bubbles).
- JS hooks: `data-fv-open`, `data-fv-dismiss`, `data-fv-tab`, `data-fv-theme-toggle`, `data-fv-theme-cycle`, `data-fv-nav-toggle`, `data-fv-copy`, `data-fv-command`, `data-tooltip`. JS API: `Farvist.toast()`, `Farvist.copy()`, `Farvist.theme()`, `Farvist.command()`, `Farvist.stream()`, `Farvist.enhance()`.
- Give the page a rich background (e.g. `<body class="bg-mesh-aurora">`) so the glass reads.
